question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Despite the __ridicule__, China looks set to carry out the three - child policy in the hope of addressing its rapidly aging population and plunging birth and marriage rates.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ridicule"** means the act of making fun of someone or something in a cruel or harsh manner; mockery. (उपहास)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite the **ridicule** he faced, he continued to pursue his dreams.
 
 
 
• **"Commend"** means to praise formally or officially; to express approval of. (प्रशंसा)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher **commended **the student for his excellent performance in the exam.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ridicule'** is **'commend'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scorn** (तिरस्कार): The feeling or belief that someone or something is worthless or despicable; contempt.

 
 
• **Example:** She looked at him with scorn after his disgraceful behavior.
 
 
 
• **Contempt** (अवमानना): The feeling that a person or a thing is beneath consideration, worthless, or deserving scorn.
 
 
• **Example: **His contempt for the rules was evident in his actions.
 
 
 
• **Taunt** (उपहास): A remark made in order to anger, wound, or provoke someone.
 
 
• **Example:** They taunted him about his old-fashioned clothes.
